research_notes: Chinese names: Amap 龙脊基地店 listing TBW攀岩(龙脊基地店); own account 东方龙脊攀岩（TBW长沙店） (TBW x 东方龙脊攀岩馆). Own RedNote account (213 followers): opening-promotion note 2026-07-15, note 2026-08-31 says the bouldering zone A (抱石A区, #室内抱石) was reset, plus youth training and top-rope courses; latest post 2026-09-24. The account gives no address; the tie to Amap is the brand TBW + 龙脊 and Changsha (the only TBW listing in Changsha; Amap 麓谷街道麓谷大道679号通发高新技术园区内). Coordinate is the listing-detail point (two identical reads; the search result differs by about 120 m), so precision is building. The English name is our translation (龙脊 = Longji, 基地 = base).
